# LinkedIn messages (sent by a person from their own profile)

LinkedIn messages are sales tasks. The agent drafts. The account owner or the client salesperson sends them by hand from their own account. No automation tool sends LinkedIn messages (this breaks LinkedIn terms).

**Connection note (300 characters or less)**
> Hi {{first_name}}, I work with {{industry}} teams on {{topic}}. I saw {{hook}}. I would like to connect and share what we learn.

**After they accept (day 2 or later)**
> Thanks for connecting, {{first_name}}. {{1_line_insight}}. We put the details in a short note — want me to send it?

**After an event or webinar**
> Good to see you at {{event}}. You asked about {{question}}. Here is the answer we promised: {{link}}.

Rules: no pitch in the connection note; no more than 1 message before they reply; GCC: a mutual introduction first when possible.
